sources.name: GitHub issues of tailwindlabs/headlessui
sources.version: GitHub REST API 2022-11-28, state as of 2026-11-11
sources.license: GitHub Terms of Service (user content; only facts and our own summaries are kept)

provenance.notes: URL, number, title, state, dates, counts and labels are copied from the API response of each issue. Category, components, summary, resolution and lesson are written by the researcher (tools/extract/field-reports/curation) after reading the issue body returned by the search API and, for the issues listed in docs/research/field-reports.md, the full thread. daysOpen of an open issue is measured to the retrieval date. fixedBy is filled mechanically from merged pull requests that name the issue after a closing keyword. Reports marked needs-review state a cause that the researcher inferred from the symptom without a confirming statement in the issue.

reports.title: Headless UI Switch Going Out of Flow on RTL
reports.summary: Under dir="rtl" the switch's thumb moved out of its track, because the documented styling translates the thumb by a positive physical amount when checked.
reports.lesson: Example and recipe code for a switch never uses an unsigned physical translate.

reports.title: Add RTL support to Tabs
reports.summary: Keyboard navigation between tabs did not follow RTL: arrow keys moved in LTR order on an RTL page.
reports.lesson: Roving focus reads direction; test: in RTL ArrowLeft moves to the next tab.
